target_reader: Developers and operators who need scripts, bots or workflow services to run independently of a local computer.
intent: Informational/commercial investigation: decide when persistent VPS hosting fits automation and how to size it.
existing_results_do_well: Cover persistent processes, root access, Docker and common automation tooling.
existing_results_miss: Distinguish server uptime from job success.
Clear restart/state design guidance without pretending one resource number fits all.
unique_value: A practical infrastructure guide centered on persistence, concurrency, restart design, OS fit, observability and acceptable-use boundaries.
commercial_connection: The plan comparison is relevant only after the reader identifies runtime/concurrency/resource needs.
cannibalization: Distinct from high-availability and upgrade-signal articles.
existence_question: Why should vps-for-automation-bots exist when search already has competing results?
